sn1.7:1.1: Ekam antaṃ ṭhitā kho sā devatā Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
sn1.7:2.1: Yesaṃ dhammā appaṭividitā || paravādesu nīyare || suttā te nappabujjhanti || kālo tesaṃ {pabujjhitun} ti || ||
sn1.7:3.1: Yesaṃ dhammā suppaṭividitā || paravādesu na nīyare || {te sambuddhā} sammadaññā || caranti visame saman ti || ||
